title: Exclude proportional pairs of native carrier fusions (no new κ)
body:
Close the proportional-row pair case left open by #6765: two individually impossible repairs could have cancelling combined errors. On the exact #6702 native word used by #6726, exclude all 122 proportional interval pairs even with arbitrarily many resident dyadic injections and free full-bank output cleanup.

The complete census has 108 shared-MOVE pairs / 439 cut systems and 14 disjoint pairs / 248 systems. Shared transport is counted once. An independent forward-SSA implementation reconstructs every row, pair, residence and response, then supplies 687 separating certificates checked by 9,199 direct dot products. A separate forward sweep confirms all 122 combined errors and no source feedback.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6702 native source: edd6a37a9ff87b254fb7466184348d1432d0c8c0.
#6765 verification source: 09cf64682381cd25094a3fa9bbf2500c51c4cde3.
SOURCES.json and ORIGINS.json retain exact source paths and hashes.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-paired-carrier-obstruction
```
Expected: PASS_P104_PAIRED_CARRIER_OBSTRUCTION in both modes and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed registered normal/-O replay and committed-byte/mode checks. Tests cover the exact rational endpoint, nonzero held rows, prime modulus and SCALE units, positive/negative span fixtures, and altered-witness/inventory/target controls. The 1.7 MB census is regenerated and hash-checked. Deterministic enumeration, no RNG seed; coverage stops at all 122 pairs and 687 threshold systems.

No new κ. Pair-only, unchanged held source and recipient schedule, dyadic coefficients, proper outputs and COPY-zero obligations retained. Simultaneous triple coupling in the 14 size-three classes remains open, as do changed sources and new paid carriers. No floating paid-stop pilot is included. Physical native, ownership/compiler/precision/analytic admission remain inherited; no selected cold replay or full-history preflight is claimed.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate implementation review. Credit #6765, @DreamingOfClouds (#6702), @zxv (#6726), and the preserved native/caller lineage. Apache-2.0.
